name: Instant Impact
description: Double points for summer signings. One player per club, six players, no goalkeeper in the formation picker, unlimited budget.

player_multipliers._note: Matches 102 players as of 2026-08-20 (was 96 on 2026-08-17 - the window is still open, so re-check before the deadline). The stated rule also includes permanent signings from loan and youth debutants, who may not carry a June-2026 join date, so this set is close but not exact.

source: https://fplchallenge.premierleague.com/ home page, re-read 2026-08-20: "Gameweek 1 Challenge - Instant Impact - Double Points for summer signings. One player per club."
